articles.title: The Precious Metals Crisis That Could Trigger a Global Financial Reckoning
articles.description: It ended, apparently, in the spring. Gold ran to a record in the last days of January 2026 — $5,608 an ounce on one spot reading, roughly $5,405 on the LBMA benchmark, and $5,318.40 on COMEX futures, three figures describing the same metal and differing by ne…
